evidence_type: historical measured results, not a new experiment
wall_scope: Draw, GPU query waiting and Present; excludes outer message pump, JSON append and final log write.
gpu_scope: Parameters/fluid, light cache, optional indirect approximation, integration, full-resolution composite and UI.
video_scope: Offline capture at a fixed 1/30 simulation step, every second frame saved, 15 fps playback; normal simulated time, not FPS proof.
reference_scope: One fixed state, shared cache; no cache spatial-convergence or physical multiple-scattering certification.
unity_scope: Initial-state parity and completed Player run only; no Unity GPU performance or evolved radiance parity certification.
